name: v1.0.5

## What's Changed
* feat(extraction): Retrieving label candidates from cards and population internal card schema, making them available in Anki by @maxoem in https://github.com/maxoem/schedae/pull/14
* build(deps): bump @hono/node-server from 1.19.13 to 1.19.18 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/maxoem/schedae/pull/13
* build(deps): bump fast-uri from 3.1.0 to 3.1.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/maxoem/schedae/pull/12
* build(deps): bump dompurify from 3.3.3 to 3.4.17 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/maxoem/schedae/pull/11

## New Contributors
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/maxoem/schedae/pull/13

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/maxoem/schedae/compare/v1.0.4...v1.0.5
